text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-v-e-l-o-p-e-d a s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e-d i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y p-r-o-f-i-l-e to m-i-m-i-c a l-o-n-g-d-i-s-t-a-n-c-e b-o-n-d, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a r-g-i-s-t-e-r a-t-i-o-n t-r-a-c-e o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e o-m-i-t-t-i-n-g i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-n-t s-e-q-u-e-n-t-i-a-l m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s b-u-i-l-d-i-n-g e-m-o-t-i-o-n-a-l t-r-u-s-t o-v-e-r w-e-e-k-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-e-d c-h-a-t l-o-g-s o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r-a-l a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d u-r-g-e-n-t f-u-n-d t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s c-i-t-i-n-g e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y s-c-e-n-a-r-i-o-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g r-e-d f-l-a-g d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-u-l-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s to r-o-u-t-e p-r-o-c-e-e-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g i-p a-d-d-r-e-s l-o-g-s o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e f-a-i-l-i-n-g t-o c-r-o-s-s r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e k-n-o-w-n n-e-t-w-o-r-k-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-e-d v-i-c-t-i-m-s to k-e-e-p s-e-c-r-e-c-y to p-r-e-v-e-n-t c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g i-g-n-o-r-e-d w-a-r-n-i-n-g s-i-g-n-a-l-s o-n f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e m-i-s-s-i-n-g s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d e-s-c-a-l-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l-s.
